# Эх сурвалж

Энэхүү сайт нь олон нийтийн эрүүл мэндийн боловсролд зориулсан бөгөөд дараах нээлттэй, мэргэжлийн эх сурвалжуудын иргэдэд зориулсан мэдээллийн зарчимд нийцүүлэн боловсруулав.

- American Stroke Association. Stroke symptoms and B.E. F.A.S.T. warning signs. <https://www.stroke.org/en/about-stroke/stroke-symptoms>
- American Heart Association. Warning signs of a heart attack. <https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/heart-attack/warning-signs-of-a-heart-attack>
- CDC. First Aid for Seizures. <https://www.cdc.gov/epilepsy/first-aid-for-seizures/index.html>
- National Kidney Foundation. CKD risk factors, testing, and prevention. <https://www.kidney.org/kidney-topics/risk-factors-chronic-kidney-disease>
- CDC. Signs and Symptoms of Autism Spectrum Disorder. <https://www.cdc.gov/autism/signs-symptoms/index.html>
- American Stroke Association. Post-stroke exercise and rehabilitation resources. <https://www.stroke.org/en/life-after-stroke/stroke-rehab/post-stroke-exercise-videos>
- MedlinePlus. Pressure injuries. <https://medlineplus.gov/pressureinjuries.html>
